description: This file is a React component for the Cart Page of an e-commerce web application. It manages cart items, applies coupons, calculates totals, and handles user interactions such as updating item quantities and removing items.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches cart items from API and updates state.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates quantity of a specific cart item via API.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart by setting its quantity to zero.

methods.name: onApply
methods.description: Validates and applies a coupon code, updating the cart's discount state.

methods.name: onRemoveCoupon
methods.description: Removes the currently applied coupon and resets related states.
